constraints.name: events_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((result ->> 'bookingId'::text) = (booking_id)::text) AND ((result ->> 'attemptId'::text) = (attempt_id)::text) AND ((result ->> 'revision'::text) = (revision)::text) AND ((result ->> 'decision'::text) = decision) AND ((result -> 'duplicate'::text) = 'false'::jsonb) AND ((result ->> 'decisionFingerprint'::text) = decision_fingerprint) AND ((result ->> 'observationFingerprint'::text) = observation_fingerprint) AND ((result -> 'operatorActionRequired'::text) = to_jsonb(operator_required))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: events_new_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((new_state ?& ARRAY['booking'::text, 'attempt'::text, 'hold'::text, 'holdPayment'::text]) AND ((new_state - ARRAY['booking'::text, 'attempt'::text, 'hold'::text, 'holdPayment'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: events_previous_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((previous_state ?& ARRAY['booking'::text, 'attempt'::text, 'hold'::text, 'holdPayment'::text]) AND ((previous_state - ARRAY['booking'::text, 'attempt'::text, 'hold'::text, 'holdPayment'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: events_result_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((result ?& ARRAY['bookingId'::text, 'attemptId'::text, 'revision'::text, 'decision'::text, 'decisionFingerprint'::text, 'observationFingerprint'::text, 'providerStatus'::text, 'bookingState'::text, 'attemptState'::text, 'operatorActionRequired'::text, 'duplicate'::text]) AND ((result - ARRAY['bookingId'::text, 'attemptId'::text, 'revision'::text, 'decision'::text, 'decisionFingerprint'::text, 'observationFingerprint'::text, 'providerStatus'::text, 'bookingState'::text, 'attemptState'::text, 'operatorActionRequired'::text, 'duplicate'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: job_receipts_attempt_id_observation_fingerprint_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id, observation_fingerprint) REFERENCES payment_projection.events(attempt_id, observation_fingerprint)

constraints.name: events_environment_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment, event_id) REFERENCES square_webhook.inbox(environment, event_id)

constraints.name: jobs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state = 'CLAIMED'::text) = ((lease_owner IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: jobs_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((lease_token IS NULL) = (lease_expires_at IS NULL)) AND ((lease_token IS NULL) = (lease_owner IS NULL))))

constraints.name: jobs_environment_merchant_id_payment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment, merchant_id, payment_id) REFERENCES payment_reconciliation.streams(environment, merchant_id, payment_id)

constraints.name: jobs_environment_source_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment, source_event_id) REFERENCES square_webhook.inbox(environment, event_id)

constraints.name: inbox_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state = 'RECONCILING'::text) = ((claim_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_until IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: inbox_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((conflict_count = 0) = ((conflict_at IS NULL) AND (last_conflict_sha256 IS NULL))))

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_attempt_id_observation_fingerprint_key ON payment_projection.events USING btree (attempt_id, observation_fingerprint)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_attempt_id_revision_key ON payment_projection.events USING btree (attempt_id, revision)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_pkey ON payment_projection.events USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX payment_projection_booking ON payment_projection.events USING btree (booking_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX heads_pkey ON payment_projection.heads USING btree (attempt_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_receipts_pkey ON payment_projection.job_receipts USING btree (job_id, attempt_id, observation_fingerprint)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_pkey ON payment_reconciliation.audit USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_pkey ON payment_reconciliation.events USING btree (environment, event_id)
CREATE INDEX reconciliation_event_job ON payment_reconciliation.events USING btree (job_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_environment_merchant_id_payment_id_generation_key ON payment_reconciliation.jobs USING btree (environment, merchant_id, payment_id, generation)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_pkey ON payment_reconciliation.jobs USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_reconciliation ON payment_reconciliation.jobs USING btree (environment, merchant_id, payment_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['READY'::text, 'CLAIMED'::text, 'RETRY_WAIT'::text]))
CREATE INDEX reconciliation_diagnostics ON payment_reconciliation.jobs USING btree (environment, updated_at DESC, id) WHERE ((state = ANY (ARRAY['BLOCKED'::text, 'DEAD'::text])) OR security_blocked)
CREATE INDEX reconciliation_due ON payment_reconciliation.jobs USING btree (environment, claim_after, id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['READY'::text, 'CLAIMED'::text, 'RETRY_WAIT'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_stops_pkey ON payment_reconciliation.provider_stops USING btree (environment, merchant_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX streams_pkey ON payment_reconciliation.streams USING btree (environment, merchant_id, payment_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inbox_pkey ON square_webhook.inbox USING btree (environment, event_id)
CREATE INDEX webhook_claim_queue ON square_webhook.inbox USING btree (environment, received_at, event_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['RECEIVED'::text, 'FAILED_RETRYABLE'::text, 'RECONCILING'::text]))
CREATE INDEX webhook_undispatched ON square_webhook.inbox USING btree (environment, received_at, event_id) WHERE ((job_dispatched_at IS NULL) AND (state = 'RECEIVED'::text) AND (conflict_count = 0))
